preamble.summary: 1 Samuel 16 narrates David's anointing by Samuel and David's introduction to Saul's court as a harpist. 4QSamᵃ preserves portions; tracks MT broadly with minor wording variants.
preamble.notable_variants: Minor wording variants only. The famous 'man looks on the outward appearance, but the LORD looks on the heart' (v. 7) tracks MT.

variant_notes: 'For the LORD does not see as man sees: man looks on the outward appearance, but the LORD looks on the heart' tracks MT.
